name: Example Library
author: Cinematica
description: A worked example of the Python provider contract: a handful of films listed in a JSON file, served from a web server you run, plus a couple of followed channels to show the optional channels role. Copy it and replace the library.
instructions: Base URL is the address this server can fetch your video files from -- everything in the library file hangs off it. Library file is the path to your own JSON list; leave it blank to use the three example rows shipped inside the package, which are there to show the shape, not to play.

config.label: Base URL
config.help: Where the files live, e.g. http://mediabox.lan:8080/films. Each title's "path" is appended to it.

config.label: Library file
config.help: Absolute path to a JSON file shaped like the library.example.json in this package. Blank uses that example file.
